svg.aria-label: crash inside the transaction: neither write survives
svg.text: Crash at any instant, process each item once — stack and heap at every step
9 items, total 45 · dupes 9/9 · losses 9/9 · one transaction exact at all 9
2 // primitive: ITEMS — the queue, numbered. Written number:value.
4 // primitive: sum — the output written to the database. Starts at 0.
5 // primitive: pos — how far the worker has recorded reading. Starts at 0.
6 // primitive: CRASH_AT — the item during which the process dies, for this trace.
10 // primitive: begin() / commit() — open and close one transaction. Everything between
11 // them lands together or not at all.
12 // begin() = 1 open transaction · after commit() both writes are durable, or neither
13 // primitive: restart(from) — the process comes back and resumes at the RECORDED pos.
14 // restart reads pos from durable storage; anything not written is gone.
17 // "A worker reads numbered items from a queue, transforms each, and writes the result
18 // to a database. It records how far it has read so a restart resumes. The process
19 // can die at ANY instant. No item may be processed twice, and none may be skipped."
21 // function: applyItem(sum, item) — the effect. Note it is NOT idempotent: running it
22 // twice moves the total twice, which is what makes a duplicate visible.
28 // function: effectThenPosition(items) — write the result, then record the position.
29 // with no crash: 45 · crashing during item 3: 47 <- 2 too much
34 // <-- a crash HERE has written the effect and not the position
40 // function: positionThenEffect(items) — record the position, then write the result.
41 // with no crash: 45 · crashing during item 3: 43 <- 2 missing
46 // <-- a crash HERE has recorded the position and not the effect
52 // function: together(items) — both writes in ONE transaction, so a crash leaves either
53 // both or neither. every crash point gives 45
61 // <-- a crash anywhere inside leaves NEITHER write
66 // function: main() — all three, crashed at every item in turn and restarted.
68 val clean = 45 // no crash, any ordering
69 val dup = 47 // effect first, crash during item 3
70 val lost = 43 // position first, crash during item 3
71 val exact = 45 // one transaction, crash during item 3
72 val dups = 9 // of 9 crash points that duplicate
73 val losses = 9 // of 9 crash points that lose
sum=15 pos=3 <- crash, both rolled back
Step 9/0 — crash inside the transaction: neither write survives
The total is still 15 and pos is still 3, so the restart does item 3 once — for the first time. **Every one of the 9 crash points gives 45**, asserted. And note
what was NOT needed: no distributed protocol, no deduplication table, no retry logic. One transaction.
